content: विकेश {%a.%} (-शी|{%f.%}) .²1 Having loose hair. .²2 Having no hair, bald (as head). .{@-शी@} .²1 A woman with loose hair. .²2 A woman without hair. .²3 A small tress of hair tied up separately and then collected into the larger braid or {%Veṇi%}. .²4 <ab>N.</ab> of the wife of Śiva in the form of the Earth (one of the 8 forms of Śiva; <ab>cf.</ab> यामाहुः सर्वभूतप्रकृतिः <ls>Ś. 1. 1.</ls>).
